info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Status API provides real-time visibility into the status of logistics shipments. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve comprehensive details regarding the current statuses of their shipments, enhancing supply chain transparency and efficiency. This API is essential for logistics managers, supply chain analysts, and businesses seeking to track shipments and optimize delivery processes. Key use cases include monitoring shipment progress, identifying delays, and ensuring timely deliveries.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of shipments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest status of your shipments. It helps track delivery progress, delays, and expected arrival times.

requestBody.description: The request body for querying the status of shipments. This body should provide necessary parameters to retrieve the current status of specified shipments. It adheres to the schema defined for handling shipment status requests.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of shipments.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the status of shipments.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the status.

audit.description: Details about the auditing of the operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving shipment status.

createdBy.description: The user who created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was executed automatically.

Audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.
